profile_resize: Awake Array.Resize to11 bodies retains first11 entries; trailing twelfth is discarded.

requests.pd: signal = P * (error + (D * (error - lastError)) * reciprocalFixedDeltaTime); lastError = error
requests.angular: FixEuler subtracts360 once only if angle>180; exact angle360 clears signal and preserves lastError.
requests.sync: For each body, only if body and master transform exist: copy master world position then rotation to body transform; catch throws a new exception named after this object.
requests.nonrigid: On secondary tick, refresh indices2 through count-2 when mimicNonRigids. On even frameCounter, write those indices regardless of mimicNonRigids; Quaternion.Lerp factor2/secondaryUpdate only when secondaryUpdate>2.
requests.controller_order: DoRagdollControl precedes active test; active drive resets totals and increments frameCounter only after drive.

scope: Disconnected numerical drive and indexed joint requests. Rig metadata is not a physics implementation.
limitations: Metadata tokens are build-local and only meaningful with the stated artifact SHA-256 and MVID.
CIL is read from file bytes; no JIT, floating-point or engine behavior is observed.
Field serialization layout is derived from pinned member flags/SerializeField attributes and checked by complete installed component byte consumption.
Static caller inventory does not establish actual enabled scene scheduling.
Engine Quaternion/Vector3 operations and actual Rigidbody/ConfigurableJoint consumption are not executed or qualified bit-exact.
Force mode2 and joint motion/drive mode integers are retained literally; no mass-dependent engine solve is supplied.
All component bytes are bound by whole installed asset hashes; Infinity joint break values are represented as explicit strings.
Collider material references are retained; a null material uses an unqualified engine default. Numeric GameObject tags are not resolved to tag names.
